question: What Are the Types of PLC Output Modules?
body_html:
PLC output module types are relay, transistor and triac, and each suits different loads, voltages and switching speeds.

TypeLoadKey point
RelayAC or DCIsolated contact, 10 to 20 ms switching
Transistor (PNP sourcing / NPN sinking)DC onlyFast, no mechanical wear
TriacAC onlyNo contact wear, small off state leakage

Fit suppression across inductive loads on relay outputs.
